name: chatgpt-pro-review
description: Ask the strictly verified visible ChatGPT Chat Pro setting flexible questions and bring the complete answer back.

interface.shortDescription: Flexible visible-Pro answers that resume cleanly
interface.longDescription: Ask a caller-defined question in visible ChatGPT Chat with Pro strictly verified, poll long responses without duplicate submission, and bring back the complete Markdown and artifacts. Repository packets and durable state are used only when useful; the calling session decides whether to request a review, ideas, explanation, design comparison, code, or another answer.
defaultPrompt: Use $chatgpt-pro-ask to ask visible ChatGPT Pro this question and return its complete response.
Use $chatgpt-pro-code-review to review this branch against main and return the complete verified Pro response.
Use $chatgpt-pro-code-review to resume the submitted review in its existing ChatGPT thread without resubmitting.
